speaker: davy_gannet
text: In. Four is a decent load and a worse balance. Sit. Do not stand up to see a thing that is still round the bend.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I will sit. I did not come to Old Swan to admire Old Swan.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not since May. The last time I stood on these stairs I would not cross. I am crossing.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Crossing, and not landing on the bank we are going to look at. Say it in the boat so the boat has heard it.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Heard. I pull along Bankside. You look. The mud can have somebody else.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Then pull. The light is long enough. My patience is not.
